name: Reiya
source:
Reiya is an orphan, so he doesn’t know what his parents’ look like.
He was influenced by Seri’s opinion to be trained as a hunter, which led to him becoming a vampire hunter.
He’s lively and optimistic, but he also hates to lose. Out of everyone, he shows the most passionate chivalry when the time comes.
He doesn’t show it, but he’s the type that gives his all.
He knows what it’s like to feel lonely, so he hates to kill vampires without reason.
He treats you like a friend, but could there be more?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.vampirehunterkaigai]Google Play[/url]]
